title: Replacing the whole memory removes the recipient path
requirements: NumPy/PyTorch for structural; trained toy checkpoints from experiment 18 for evaluate

structural.note:
Fresh structural check on randomly initialized toy models.

This intentionally needs no trained checkpoint: whole-memory donor parity is
an identity of the access contract. It is separate from the trained records.

evaluate.note: Includes the whole-memory control. Requires the six models and calibration produced by experiment 18.
